basics.name: Aarav Mehta
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer · Payments & Platform
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 4+ years building payment systems and developer platforms in TypeScript, Node.js and AWS. Cut checkout latency by 77% and cloud spend by 31% at Contoso Pay. Seeking a senior or staff platform role.

work.name: Contoso Pay
highlights: Rebuilt the checkout API in Node.js, cutting p95 latency from 820 ms to 190 ms across 3M+ payments a month.
Designed an AWS reconciliation pipeline (Lambda, SQS, PostgreSQL) that flags 99.7% of mismatches in 5 minutes.
Reduced AWS spend by 31% ($18k a month) by right-sizing services and moving cold data to cheaper storage tiers.
Mentored 4 engineers and moved the team to trunk-based development, taking deploys from weekly to 12 a week.

work.name: Fabrikam Cloud
highlights: Built a React and TypeScript analytics dashboard for 1,200+ enterprise admins, lifting weekly active usage by 22%.
Shipped a Python service that routes support tickets with a scikit-learn classifier, saving support 35 hours a week.
Migrated 14 Java services to Kubernetes with Docker and Helm, cutting release time from 2 hours to 15 minutes.

work.name: Northwind Traders
highlights: Prototyped a demand forecast in Python and SQL that reduced stock-outs by 18% across 40 pilot stores, then automated 6 weekly reports into one Power BI dashboard.

projects.name: Ledgerline
projects.description: Open-source double-entry ledger library for Node.js with idempotent writes and a full audit trail.
highlights: Grew to 2.1k GitHub stars and 30+ production users with 98% test coverage.

projects.name: Tandem
projects.description: Real-time collaborative whiteboard built on WebSockets and CRDTs.
highlights: Sustained 60 fps with 50 concurrent editors in load tests; offline edits merge without conflicts.

projects.name: DocsPilot
projects.description: Retrieval-augmented assistant for internal engineering docs, built with Python and FastAPI.
highlights: Answered 78% of 1,900 questions without escalation in a 6-week pilot.
